dct_title_s: Map of the city of Boston for 1891.
dct_alternative_sm: Map of the city of Boston for 1891.
dct_description_sm: Covers also parts of adjacent towns and cities, including all of Cambridge, Somerville, and Brookline. "Published expressly for the Boston directory." "Heliotype Printing Co." Shows radial distances from City Hall.
